subject: Can't use snpclone as input in genotype_curve?

messages.author: 04e71feb5b4997db
messages.subject: Can't use snpclone as input in genotype_curve?
parts:
I'm wanting to calculate a genotype accumulation curve, but am using a snpclone object, and it appears this is an unacceptable input for the genotype_curve function. I am wondering if it is appropriate to convert my snpclone/genlight object to a genind object in order to run this analysis?

Thanks,
Dallas

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Can't use snpclone as input in genotype_curve?
parts: It is not inappropriate to convert your data, but the size of your data will limit what you can do with it due to your computational memory constraints.
